name: ThemeForge
notes: One entry per theme. css = the file in src/css that holds the theme's [data-palette] block; Purple has none because it is the :root base inside theme-base.css.
ground is oled | dark | light. The runtime derives <html data-theme> from it: oled -> amoled, dark -> dark, light -> light.
family groups a dark/light pair for apps that offer a dark/light switch (laserlloyd <-> laserlloyd-light).
set is core (offered by default) or opt-in (only where an app lists it in data-themes).
contrastProfile (optional) names the floor set tools/check_contrast.py applies: standard (the default) or night (red-on-black night themes; see the tool's docstring).
swatch is the picker dot colour. fonts are web-font families the theme names first in its stacks; every stack falls back to system fonts, so none of them has to be installed.
